proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.active_payload_prefix: opaque session_id[16] before original per-TYPE fields
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.active_ack_payload: session_id[16] + acked_seq LE32; header.seq equal acked_seq
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.active_nack_payload: session_id[16] + expected_seq LE32; header.seq rejected frame seq
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.link_session_bootstrap_security_assumpti: trusted PC with fresh CSPRNG SID; not cryptographic authentication; power-cycle replay risk not eliminated absolutely
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.ACTIVATE_READY_revision: R1 includes cpi_valid full OFFER snapshot echo; +1 B in both ACTIVATE and READY compared to v0.1
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.FPGA_app_seq_initialization: first valid ACTIVATE in NEGOTIATING once per SID; latch activated_once before sending READY
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.PC_app_seq_initialization: first valid matching READY once per SID; no reliable application data before READY
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.lost_READY_behaviour: resend exact cached READY on same SID ACTIVATE; do not reset active reliable counters even if seq already advanced
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.HOST_DISCARDED_INCOMPLETE_COMMIT: Only after approved explicit host failure disposition, durable missing-ID journal, verified immutable COMMIT/count; host result FAILED, not PASS, preserve FPGA COMMIT tombstone
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.RECOVER_UNKNOWN_scope: FPGA global reset/powerloss -> UNKNOWN; PC locally validated durable result retained but not asserted as FPGA outcome; provisional invalidated; new full IQ upload
trusted_lab_assumptions: one authorized PC writer has exclusive CP2102 port
PC closes previous handle and purges TX/RX queues
PC records 2-second receive quiet interval after reenumeration (only a proposal, not a USB latency guarantee)
PC creates new nonzero 128-bit SID from OS CSPRNG, checks own SID history
PC records a durable host CPI journal and verifies flush in restart test
no delayed complete prior HELLO/ACTIVATE injected after purge by trusted host
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.after_powerloss_bootstrap_limit: Host nonce not a cryptographic proof of new device incarnation; stale complete bootstrap after FPGA loses state cannot be absolutely rejected
proposed_new_wire_changes_NOT_APPROVED.RELEASE_audit_id: nonzero trusted-PC host journal entry ID, not a proof of fsync or approval

wire_audit_scope: S02 frame structural/CRC lengths and arithmetic only; no Packetizer/Parser, ISim, UART RTL, board test or semantic state-machine execution

handshake_state_invariants_R1.FPGA_activated_once_latch: first valid ACTIVATE with complete OFFER echo and NEGOTIATING; atomically initializes seq and caches exact READY
handshake_state_invariants_R1.duplicate_ACTIVATE_AFTER_READY_LOST: same cached READY, never reinitialize sequence or process CPI again
handshake_state_invariants_R1.proof_property: activation_count(SID) <=1 while protected session state is retained; state invariant only, RTL verification NOT RUN
handshake_state_invariants_R1.USB_mid_handshake_disconnect: always new SID on reconnect, old SID responses rejected, preserve actual FPGA pending/terminal CPI
handshake_state_invariants_R1.negotiation_snapshot: freeze OFFER; if snapshot changes reject ACTIVATE; include cpi_valid in R1 complete echo

host_commit_and_release_R1.immutable_FPGA_COMMIT_count: never change on serial retry exhaustion or host incomplete delivery
host_commit_and_release_R1.failed_host_delivery: HOST_DISCARDED_INCOMPLETE_COMMIT requires approved explicit failure, durable journal, no partial successful result
host_commit_and_release_R1.idempotent_release: retain volatile CPI_ID/outcome/count/resolution/accepted_release_seq tombstone; wrong IDs and mismatched count rejected
host_commit_and_release_R1.lost_release_ACK: no automatic next CPI; reconcile through identical retry or status query
host_commit_and_release_R1.audit_id_u64LE: required nonzero PC durable host journal reference; FPGA checks structure, not disk durability

unknown_recovery_R1.FPGA_after_global_reset_or_power_loss: NO_RETAINED_STATE, historical terminal unknown; no invented COMMIT or ABORT
unknown_recovery_R1.host_durably_committed: preserve validated local result, separately mark FPGA history UNKNOWN

test_plan_R1.expected_observables: per-case raw wire CRC, PC/FPGA state/counters, SID, terminal count, replay frame hash and host journal for safety/recovery
